sql: SELECT region, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE region = 'East' GROUP BY region ORDER BY region
SELECT substr(order_date, 1, 7) AS month, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE region = 'East' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
SELECT region, SUM(revenue) AS revenue, SUM(revenue * 0.9) AS discounted_revenue FROM sales WHERE region = 'East' GROUP BY region ORDER BY region
SELECT SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE region = 'East'
SELECT category, SUM(revenue) AS revenue FROM sales WHERE region = 'East' GROUP BY category ORDER BY category
